text.description_html:
AHI SIG777-630 5-5/16" Long Stainless Steel Flush Pull with Flush Cover

For use on pocket doors, sliding doors, cabinet doors, or any door where a "flush with the door face" pull is desired. Very contemporary offset rectangular sliding door flush pull with clean lines and a spring loaded flush cover. The flush pull's opening is exposed with a gentle push of your finger. Remove your finger and the cover springs out re-concealing the pull's opening for the ultimate clean appearance. The housing between the 1/16" thick satin stainless steel front and back plates is black high impact plastic, allowing the flush pull to be pressure mounted into the door for a clean installation (no screws). It can also be thrubolted from the back side if used on pantry or cabinet door.

Also available: Stainless Steel Rectangular Flush Door Pull, Modern Square Flush Door Pull, Contemporary Rectangular Flush Door Pull and Extra Long Flush Door Pull.

Specifications for the AHI SIG777-630 Long Flush Door Pull:

  • Total Height: 5-5/16" (135 mm)
  • Total Width: 2-3/4" (70 mm)
  • Total Depth: 3/4" (19 mm)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 21/32" (17 mm)
  • Projection: 1/16" (2 mm)
  • Finger Opening Height: 3-15/16" (100 mm)
  • Finger Opening Width: 1" (25 mm)
  • Door Cutout Opening Height: 4-15/16" (125 mm)
  • Door Cutout Opening Width: 1-13/16" (46 mm)
  • Lip: 5/16" (8 mm)
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish

Available in Satin Stainless Steel finish only.

*Sold Individually
